interpretation.filename_baseline: rg --files listing proxy, NOT the true TUI walker
interpretation.cached_filter: in-process substring filtering, NOT CLI discovery or a TUI insertion test
interpretation.latency: CLI wall time includes spawn and IPC when delegated, not public-tool latency
interpretation.default_indexed: index-eligible flags; actual routing is not instrumented
interpretation.at_compatible: source-known index bypass: --hidden for content; --hidden and --no-require-git for files
interpretation.git_exclusion: raw !.git and !.git/** results retained separately from adapter filtering
interpretation.FFF: Separately measured actual public Tool calls below. Not directly comparable with tgrep CLI timing. Exact FFF/linked output equality was asserted.
interpretation.limits: periodically monitored budgets, not hard OS resource limits
interpretation.index_cpu: index uses RAYON_NUM_THREADS=floor(cores/4), min 1; serve uses --max-cpu 25
interpretation.source: pinned v1.0.4 search.rs filename_index_compatible and bypass_index; serve.rs status
interpretation.privacy: no stdout, stderr, repository matches or repository path differences persisted
interpretation.non_git: Final run used real macOS user temp for a 421-byte synthetic fixture after detecting ancestor Git in scratch. All indexes and large files stayed in scratch.

non_git.fallback: owned system-temp fixture; all indexes and output remain in scratch

recommendations.at_selection: Retain current walker/cache. Compatible tgrep discovery bypasses index and was slower.
recommendations.agent_content: Retain current FFF/linked routes. Literal paths-only acceleration merits gated follow-up, but JSON/glob and freshness mismatches block default replacement.

evidence_reduction: Repeated sample_ms arrays and identical per-round parity objects collapsed; all measured raw_ms arrays retained. Resource timeline reduced to observation count and observed peaks. Full local report hash retained.
